title: End-to-End Beta Reader Workflow
objective: Menguji clearance, spoiler preview, paket berbagi, komentar, revoke, dan sanitasi metadata.

evidence.audience_profiles: Registered beta audience is bound to the reader grant.
evidence.redaction_results: Major spoiler content is replaced with [disensor] for a clean beta audience.
evidence.share_results: Encyclopedia JSON share contains only reader-visible entries.
evidence.revocation_results: Revoked reader access is rejected before a new workflow run.
evidence.leakage_tests: Internal reader ID and metadata keys are absent from the sanitized share.
evidence.acceptance: Local deterministic synthetic tracer; native GUI, hosted CI, signing, hardware, and public release remain outside this evidence.
